entries.4058adbf6b24225e: Its management philosophy is: 'Contributing to the world and creating rich lives for employees by taking on the challenge of overcoming disease and promoting health with advanced technology.' Its long-term vision toward 2030, 'BEACON 2030,' aims to create a better future for people and healthcare by solving global medical challenges. Its medium-term management plan, 'BEACON 2030 Phase II,' covers the fiscal years 2024 to 2026 and states that it will implement company-wide earnings reform, fully commit to investment in growth areas, and pursue six key measures, including strengthening product competitiveness and focusing on growth in the North American business.

entries.53a426b54c809ee4: It develops and manufactures biological measurement equipment such as electroencephalographs and electrocardiographs, biological information monitors that continuously measure electrocardiograms, blood oxygen saturation and other parameters, and therapeutic equipment such as defibrillators, AEDs and ventilators. It also handles specimen testing equipment, reagents and medical information systems, and is working on digital health solutions that utilize data obtained from medical devices. In addition, the handling of imported Abbott products (electrode catheters, cardiac pacemakers and ablation catheters) is scheduled to end with the expiry of the contract in December 2026.

entries.559737ec8ff9fd88: As a manufacturer specializing in medical electronic equipment since its founding in 1951, the company develops and manufactures in-house in the fields of biological measurement, biological information monitoring and therapeutic equipment. Because the company group also handles the supply of consumables, repairs and maintenance after equipment is sold, its relationships with customers continue. In North America, the company has locally developing and manufacturing subsidiaries, including Defibtech (AEDs), Nihon Kohden Orange Medical (ventilators) and Adtech (intracranial electrodes), and its structure for developing products suited to local needs is also a feature.
